claims.evidence: One source per (SILAC state x preparation series x arm). State: paper Methods '5 mg K8R10 Nedd4 siRNA and 5 mg K0R0 control siRNA'. Series: OK20130809 = MaxQuant Total 'Rep1' / Ub 'Exp2'; OK20130818 = Total 'Rep2' / Ub 'Exp3'; PM2013 = Ub 'Exp1' (PM20131210_Ub_3uL, raw folder OK20131217_PeterUb) and PM20131206_Total_1uL (raw folder OK20131206_PMNedd4Total_1uL, never searched). Arm suffix keeps the (source, bio rep, tech rep, fraction) coordinate unique: total and K-eps-GG material of one series are the 50 uL pre-enrichment aliquot and the enriched remainder of the same fractions (paper Methods). Linking PM20131206_Total to the PM20131210_Ub series is inferred from operator prefix/folder name/date.

limitations: Paper reports TWO biological replicates (Results; Fig. 1b, 2a), but the deposit holds THREE run series per arm. The Ub MaxQuant search treats PM20131210_Ub_3uL1-8 as a third experiment (Exp1); it correlates with the other two no better than they do with each other (r 0.79/0.81 vs 0.81), so it is annotated as biological replicate 3. Whether it is an independent culture or a second preparation from a replicate-1/2 lysate is not stated anywhere.

PM20131206_Total_1uL1-8 (8 runs, rows 81-96) are in neither deposited MaxQuant search nor the Total experimentalDesignTemplate. Their label map rests on the generic protocol statement (all SILAC mixes = K8R10 Nedd4 siRNA + K0R0 control siRNA) and cannot be data-checked; their pairing with the PM20131210_Ub series (biological replicate 3) is inferred from operator prefix, raw-folder name 'OK20131206_PMNedd4Total_1uL' and date. Tolerances not applicable (batch rule 5), which makes parse_sdrf convert-openms fail on the full file (it succeeds on rows 1-80).
Modification columns on the unsearched rows 81-96: Carbamidomethyl and the Arg10/Lys8 labels are kept (stated sample chemistry); Oxidation, Acetyl and GG (search choices) are not applicable.
The deposited Total search also contains OK20130809_PMSILACTotal_P1-8 (non-'S' runs, pooled with TotalS as Rep1) which were NOT deposited; they are not annotated.

Paper numbers (e.g. 4988 total protein groups observed, 4381 quantified, 4015 Ub sites) exceed the deposited searches (4147 / 3609 protein groups; 3294 quantified non-contaminant Ub sites over three experiments), so the published tables likely came from a search that is not deposited.

NCU10K is absent from Cellosaurus/CLO/BTO/EFO: cellosaurus accession/name not available; developmental stage, strain, sex and passage number of the line are not stated in the paper or the cited origin paper abstract (PMID 24080509) -> not available.
Precursor tolerance (6 ppm main search) comes from paper/PRIDE prose; MaxQuant 1.3.0.5 parameters.txt does not record it and no mqpar.xml was deposited.
MaxQuant search enzyme rule was Trypsin/P with 2 missed cleavages; SDRF carries the digestion enzyme Trypsin (batch rule 2).
K-eps-GG enrichment has no specific ontology term; 'sample enrichment' (EFO:0009106) used.
Sample storage temperature not stated -> not available.
